def snapRest (sp pm pc : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (sv : SnapshotM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ds pi pt uf ufm,
      "%Hnn" ∷ ⌜sp ≠ null ∧ pm ≠ null⌝ ∗
        "HD" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Snapshot [68#8, 97#8, 116#8, 97#8] sp) ds dq ∗
          "Hd" ∷ ownSlice ds sv.Data' dq ∗
            "HM" ∷
                typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Snapshot [77#8, 101#8, 116#8, 97#8, 100#8, 97#8, 116#8, 97#8] sp) pm
                  dq ∗
              "HC" ∷
                  typedPointsto
                    (structFieldRef raftpb.SnapshotMetadata [67#8, 111#8, 110#8, 102#8, 83#8, 116#8, 97#8, 116#8, 101#8]
                      pm)
                    pc dq ∗
                "HI" ∷
                    typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.SnapshotMetadata [73#8, 110#8, 100#8, 101#8, 120#8] pm) pi dq ∗
                  "#cI" ∷ cellRO pi sv.Metadata'.Index' ∗
                    "HT" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.SnapshotMetadata [84#8, 101#8, 114#8, 109#8] pm) pt dq ∗
                      "#cT" ∷ cellRO pt sv.Metadata'.Term' ∗
                        "#Hpb" ∷ pbMsg raftpb.Snapshot sp uf ∗ "#Hpbm" ∷ pbMsg raftpb.SnapshotMetadata pm ufm)

theorem ownSnapM_tie [package_sem : Assumptions] (sp pm pc : Loc) (dq dq2 : DFrac) (sv : SnapshotM)
    : ownSnapM sp dq sv ∗ snapRest sp pm pc dq2 sv ⊢ snapRest sp pm pc dq sv ∗ csOptA pc dq
    sv.Metadata'.ConfState' ∗ snapRest sp pm pc dq2 sv

theorem snapRest_split [package_sem : Assumptions] (sp pm pc : Loc) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) (sv :
    SnapshotM) : snapRest sp pm pc (dq1 • dq2) sv ⊢ snapRest sp pm pc dq1 sv ∗ snapRest sp pm pc dq2
    sv

theorem snapRest_combine [package_sem : Assumptions] (sp pm pc : Loc) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) (sv :
    SnapshotM) : snapRest sp pm pc dq1 sv ∗ snapRest sp pm pc dq2 sv ⊢ snapRest sp pm pc (dq1 • dq2)
    sv
